purpose: Package an already human-approved proposal for a future execution adapter without executing or mutating canonical state.
guardrails: all required approvals must be HUMAN and distinct
accepted evidence and bound evidenceContextHashSha256 are required
proposalDigestSha256 and approval digests are bound into the packet
packet has a deterministic idempotency key
PREPARED can become EXPORTED only through local JSON export
ACK_PENDING never claims an external ACK
no execution endpoint or execute control exists
